spans.s:
(ओ, औ) ओभञ्जौ r. 7th cl. (भनक्ति)
To break, to destroy.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what breaks, severs, divides, destroys, &c.
E.
भञ्ज to break, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्)
Breaking, destroying.
E.
भञ्ज, and शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Breaking, destroying.
2 Afflicting.
E.
भञ्ज to break, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
A disease of the mouth, contortion of the lips, and decay of the teeth.
E.
भञ्जन, and कन् added.

m. (-रुः)
A tree growing near a temple.
E.
भञ्ज to break, अरुन् aff.
